title: Convert Documentation to Code Comments
prompt:
Convert external documentation into inline code comments for this code:

External documentation:
[PASTE DOCS — README section, wiki page, spec, API docs]

Code to annotate:
[PASTE CODE]

## Comment Strategy
Apply the right type of comment at the right level:

### File-Level Comment
At the top of the file: purpose, main responsibilities, key dependencies.

### Function/Method Comments (JSDoc / docstring format)
For each public function:
\
